references.text: Moses commands the people to keep the Lord's commandments and statutes, which form the foundation of the covenant.
The introduction to the section explaining the purpose of keeping God's commandments, testimonies, and statutes.
An exhortation to keep the Lord's commandments and walk in his ways, addressing the same theme of obedience.
A command to love the Lord and keep his statutes, commandments, and laws, using a parallel structure.
The Lord promises blessing to those who keep his commandments and statutes.
Blessed are those who guard the Lord's testimonies and seek him with all their heart.
The psalmist keeps the Lord's testimonies, using the same terminology for testimonies (עֵדֹת).
Solomon exhorts to keep the Lord's commandments and statutes, which are connected to the Mosaic Law.
Jesus says that whoever loves him will keep his commandments, reflecting the same principle of obedience to God's word.
Love for God is shown by keeping his commandments, fulfilling this Old Testament principle.
